title: Interior Car Detailing in Duncan & the Cowichan Valley: What's Included and What It Costs
metaDescription: Get a spotless, fresh-smelling cabin with professional interior car detailing in Duncan, BC. See what's included, pricing from $119, and why Cowichan Valley drivers need it.
excerpt: A closer look at our Interior Detail service: what's included, how it's priced, and why it matters more than you think if you're driving around the Cowichan Valley.

content.text: Most people think about detailing in terms of shine on the outside, but the cabin of your car is where you actually spend your time. If it's covered in dog hair, ground-in sand from Cowichan Bay beach trips, or that stale coffee smell that never quite goes away, an Interior Detail is the service that fixes it. Here's exactly what's included, what it costs, and when Duncan and Cowichan Valley drivers tend to need it most.
What's Included in an Interior Detail

items: Full vacuum of seats, carpets, floor mats, trunk, and hard-to-reach spots like under the seats and between the console and seat rails
Steam cleaning and shampooing of carpets and fabric seats to lift stains and ground-in dirt
Leather cleaning and conditioning where applicable, to prevent cracking and fading
Wipe-down and UV protectant on the dash, door panels, center console, and trim
Interior glass cleaned streak-free, inside windshield included
Air vents detailed and cabin air freshened
Door jambs and seat tracks cleaned, where grit and salt tend to build up unnoticed

content.text: Our Interior Detail starts at $119 for a sedan, $139 for an SUV, and $159 for a truck or larger vehicle. Pricing depends on vehicle size and condition — heavy pet hair, mud, or spills that have had time to set in may add to the base price, but we always confirm cost before we start work, no surprises on the invoice.

Living in the Cowichan Valley means your car's interior takes a beating in ways a lot of detailers in bigger cities never see. A few common triggers we hear from customers around Duncan, Cobble Hill, and Mill Bay:

items: Sand and salt tracked in after a day at Cowichan Bay or Maple Bay beaches
Muddy paws and shedding after hikes near Shawnigan Lake or Lake Cowichan
Kids' spilled drinks, crumbs, and sticky handprints from the school run
Dust and pollen buildup on the dash and vents through spring and summer
Musty odors from damp gear after fishing or boating trips

content.text: If your interior needs work but your paint, wheels, and exterior are in decent shape, the Interior Detail on its own is the right call and saves you money. If both the inside and outside need attention, our Full Detail bundles interior and exterior work together starting at $179 for a sedan, and works out cheaper than booking the two services separately.

Ready to get your cabin back to like-new condition? We come to you anywhere in Duncan, Cowichan Bay, Maple Bay, Cobble Hill, Mill Bay, Shawnigan Lake, Chemainus, Crofton, Ladysmith, or Lake Cowichan. Call or text 250-709-1371 for a free quote, or let us know your vehicle and we'll give you an exact price before we book.
